title: Filipino Buried Lechon
description: A traditional Filipino dish of slow-cooked pork wrapped in banana leaves, perfect for special occasions. The combination of flavors and textures will transport you to the Philippines.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine pork, bisik, fish sauce, black pepper, garlic, and onion. Mix well.
Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add a small amount of oil and sear the pork until browned on all sides.
Transfer the pork to a baking dish and cover with banana leaves.
Bake for 2-3 hours, or until the pork is tender and easily shreds with a fork.
Let the pork rest for 10-15 minutes before slicing and serving.
